title: Paneer Dessert
description: A sweet and nutty dessert featuring paneer as the main ingredient. Perfect for those with a sweet tooth.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together crumbled paneer, honey, and cardamom powder until well combined.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
3. Add the paneer mixture to the pan and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
4. Add the chopped almonds to the pan and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
5. Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool down to room temperature.
6. Refrigerate the mixture for at least 30 minutes before serving.
